name: Leman Street
source: Laid out in the 1680s by Sir William Leman across Goodman's Fields; first building leases on its frontage Aug 1682 (John Hooper): Survey of London, Whitechapel (vols 54-55, 2022), surveyoflondon.org/map/feature/1457 and /1300

name: Cable Street
source: Road east from the Tower postern called Hachestreet by 1250 (later Hog Lane, Rosemary Lane); the part through Wapping known as Cable Street by 1703: VCH Middx xi pp.7-13 (Stepney: Communications), british-history.ac.uk/vch/middx/vol11/pp7-13. Year = first record of the name. CLIPPED to the window: 548 of 1626 m inside

source: Existence/date [FACT]; line is an approximation at ~1 tile: Church consecrated 19 Jul 1729, parish carved from Stepney (Wapping-Stepney hamlet): stgitehistory.org.uk/history.html; VCH Middx xi.
